profile.name: Florian Grima
profile.summary: I’m a machine learning engineer with four years of experience in software engineering and AI consulting. I connect models, data, and software to build useful systems — from internal RAG tools to backend architecture and AI workflows.

hero.description: I’m Florian, an ML engineer in Lyon. I turn ideas into software, connect knowledge to models, and make AI useful in the real world.

studies.title: Expert in Information Technology & Software Engineering
studies.description: Diplôme d’Expert en technologies de l’information and Expert en ingénierie logicielle, registered at RNCP level 7. A project-based education in computer science and software engineering.

studies.title: International exchange year
studies.description: Fourth-year study abroad, with a focus on software engineering and AI.

careers.title: AI Consultant
careers.description: Built an internal RAG tool connected to the company’s Notion knowledge base and designed an AI workflow architecture for the communication department.
highlights: Improved workflow productivity by 30% in six months through AI tooling, targeted training, and support.
Designed and implemented the communication department’s AI workflow architecture within three months.

careers.title: Teaching Assistant · Internship
careers.description: Evaluated AI projects across four cohorts and developed workshops that made complex concepts accessible through Python, PyTorch, and collaborative learning.
highlights: Supported students working in C, C++, Python, Node.js, and PyTorch.
Developed an AI workshop program in six months and improved student engagement by 35% over twelve months.

careers.title: Fullstack Engineer · Freelance
careers.description: Migrated the backend from JavaScript to TypeScript, optimized Firebase communication, and redesigned the mobile application’s interface.
highlights: Reduced bugs by 20% and backend response times by 70% within three months.
Improved user engagement by 60% within four months by integrating user feedback into the interface.

careers.title: Fullstack Engineer
careers.description: Built a competitive gaming performance tracking tool and an AWS workflow connecting the frontend, backend, and data science stacks.
highlights: Improved user retention by 15% through analytics and feedback integration within three months.
Connected software and data science systems through a dedicated AWS workflow.

projects.name: Energizer
projects.description: A machine learning library optimized for Apple chips. Exploring the connection between model performance and the hardware underneath.
projects.details: A personal project exploring machine learning on Apple hardware, with Python, PyTorch, Metal, and CUDA. Related experiments include MLX and CoreML.

projects.name: P.A.R.S.E
projects.description: An internal RAG tool that connects company knowledge in Notion to an AI retrieval workflow.
projects.details: Built during the AI consulting engagement at TAKER. P.A.R.S.E brings internal Notion content into a retrieval-augmented generation workflow, as part of the company’s broader adoption of AI tools.

projects.name: LibrOpen
projects.description: A web application for sharing personal projects, discovering open-source work, and giving builders more visibility.
projects.details: My final-year project at EPITECH: a platform designed to help people showcase their personal projects and explore the work of other developers.

projects.name: Sirius
projects.description: A life simulator using AI prediction to explore how intelligent systems evolve.
projects.details: A personal and academic exploration of life simulation with AI prediction, using Python and PyTorch.

projects.name: R-Type
projects.description: A multiplayer side-scrolling shooter built from scratch in C++ and SFML.
projects.details: A networked game built from the ground up in C++, bringing together real-time gameplay, multiplayer communication, and a 2D side-scrolling world.
